{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Fix: Parse revenue as float after removing commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Focus on conversion rate by customer_segment
# Conversion rate = proportion of converted orders within each segment
conversion_rates = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Sort by conversion rate descending to find the highest
conversion_rates_sorted = conversion_rates.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Get the segment with the highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rates_sorted.index[0]

# Print the conversion rates for verification
conversion_rates_sorted"}
